mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_PASSWORD_RESET_RATE_LIMITS (target, day_key, daily_count, last_requested_at, last_token) VALUES (#{target}, #{dayKey}, 1, #{now}, #{token}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_token = IF(last_requested_at <= #{now} - INTERVAL #{cooldownSeconds} SECOND AND daily_count < #{dailyLimit}, #{token}, last_token), last_requested_at = IF(last_token = #{token}, #{now}, last_requested_at), daily_count = IF(last_token = #{token}, daily_count + 1, daily_count)
